title: Moroccan Kiwifruit Chebakia
description: A sweet and tangy twist on traditional Indian chebakia, incorporating the flavors of Morocco and the sweetness of kiwifruit.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine all-purpose flour, semolina flour, coconut sugar, and cardamom powder.
Gradually add in the ghee or vegetable oil and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin sheet, about 3-4 inches in diameter.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Cook the chebakia for 30-40 seconds on each side, until they are golden brown.
Dust the chebakia with powdered sugar.
Drizzle the kiwifruit jam over the chebakia.
Garnish with diced kiwifruit and rose water.
